name: cell_skin
desc:
The physical boundary layer between the internal somatic graph and the external environment.
MCP-native, audit-ready, replay-verifiable.

name: AllowAllSkinAuth
desc: A permissive gatekeeper that accepts all incoming signals without verification.

name: AllowAllSkinAuth.new
desc: Creates a new AllowAllSkinAuth gatekeeper.

name: authenticate
desc: Resolves every impulse to a Neutral Signature.

name: BadArgumentsException
desc: An exception thrown when a Nervous Signal contains a malformed Skin Payload.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: ContextBridge
desc:
The translation layer that converts external identities into internal
framework provenance.

name: resolve
desc: Maps a verified principal to a framework Context.

name: DescribeContextBridge
desc: The default translator that stamps signals with a descriptive identity.

name: resolve
desc: Maps a verified principal to a framework Context.

name: IdempotencyClaim
desc: What a claim means for one key.

name: IdempotencyOwned
desc: This caller owns the attempt: nothing is stored for the key yet.

name: IdempotencyRecord
desc: One stored attempt.

name: failureCode
desc:
When non-null, the stored attempt failed after the state was
committed (a strict-receipt violation): replays echo this
WireError code and message instead of an outcome, and never
re-apply. A failed record still has the original request's
fingerprint — a different body on the same key is still
idempotency_conflict.

name: failureMessage
desc: The wire error message for failureCode.

name: fingerprint
desc:
The SHA-256 fingerprint of the request (cellId, function,
positional, named, lastSeenSeq). A different body on the same key
is idempotency_conflict.

name: liveOutcome
desc: The live outcome, for SkinClient.apply callers in this process.

name: outcomeJson
desc:
The wire-safe outcome JSON. liveOutcome is same-process only;
this map is what a later file or SQL store is allowed to persist.

name: responseType
desc: The pulse type the stored outcome was first sent under.

name: storedAt
desc: When the attempt completed (the store's clock at complete time).

name: IdempotencyReplay
desc:
A completed attempt exists for the key. The caller must replay
record (or refuse it, when the fingerprint differs) — never apply
again.

name: IdempotencyStore
desc: The idempotency seam the router consults once per apply.

name: IdempotencyWait
desc:
Another attempt with the same key is still in flight. Await settled
and replay the record — or, when it completes with null (the owner
aborted), claim once more and become the owner.

name: JsonSchema
desc: The technical blueprint describing the shape and constraints of a somatic signal.

name: JsonSchema.fromJson
desc:
Decodes a JsonSchema from its JSON form. Lenient where the spec
is richer than this subset: type may be an array (the first
entry wins) and additionalProperties may be a schema object
(treated as true — the subset accepts it as open; a client that
re-validates a decoded schema does not get the object form
enforced).

name: additionalProperties
desc: Whether the membrane allows extra, non-modelled data to pass through.

name: description
desc: Human-readable context describing the somatic purpose of this field.

name: enumValues
desc: The allowed somatic vocabulary for this signal.

name: extra
desc: Non-modelled technical metadata preserved from the original signal.

name: items
desc: The blueprint for elements within a signal sequence (array).

name: maximum
desc: The upper somatic threshold for numeric signals.

name: minimum
desc: The lower somatic threshold for numeric signals.

name: permissive
desc: The permissive blueprint: accepts any Nervous Signal.

name: properties
desc: The internal structure of a complex Skin Payload.

name: required
desc:
The list of mandatory Somatic Nutrients (arguments) that must be
present for the signal to be valid.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: type
desc: The physical category of the signal (e.g., 'object', 'string', 'integer').

name: McpAdapter
desc: The lifecycle contract for bridging the somatic graph to an AI agent via the Model Context Protocol.

name: close
desc: Closes the Synaptic Bridge and releases the physical transport.

name: start
desc: Opens the Synaptic Bridge and begins broadcasting the system's capabilities.

name: McpResourceSpec
desc: A transport-neutral definition of an observational somatic resource.

name: McpResourceSpec.new
desc: Creates a new McpResourceSpec to describe an observational point.

name: name
desc: The human-readable name of the somatic resource.

name: uri
desc: The authoritative URI for the resource.

name: McpToolCall
desc: A tool call decoded from an MCP tool name.

name: McpToolSpec
desc: A transport-neutral definition of an interactable somatic function, formatted for AI consumption.

name: McpToolSpec.new
desc: Creates a new McpToolSpec to describe an exposed somatic function.

name: cellId
desc: The binding's cell id, as the manifest exposed it.

name: description
desc: A human and AI-readable description of the tool's somatic purpose.

name: dottedName
desc: The raw binding name: <cellId>.<functionName>, dots included.

name: functionName
desc: The binding's function name, as the manifest exposed it.

name: inputSchema
desc: The technical blueprint defining the valid arguments for the tool.

name: name
desc: The escaped MCP tool name — the only name a host registers.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the spec into its Skin Form (JSON) for transport.

name: MemoryIdempotencyStore
desc: The default in-memory store.

name: RemoteCellClient
desc: A local handle representing a distant somatic entity behind a remote membrane.

name: RemoteCellClient.inProcess
desc: Creates an In-Process Axon connected to a local SkinClient.

name: call
desc: Stimulates the remote cell to perform a Somatic State Transition.

name: cellId
desc: The unique Somatic Address of the remote cell.

name: observe
desc: Subscribes to the remote cell's External Echo.

name: observeStream
desc: The mechanism for listening to the remote cell's External Echo.

name: transport
desc: The physical seam used to transmit signals across the membrane.

name: SchemaObserver
desc: The collector responsible for learning the system's DNA by watching signals.

name: namedSchemas
desc: The cumulative Somatic Blueprint for all observed named signals.

name: observe
desc: Records the traits of a single Command Journey to update the DNA.

name: positionalSchemas
desc: The cumulative Somatic Blueprint for observed positional sequences.

name: SkinAuth
desc: The gatekeeper responsible for identifying external actors at the membrane.

name: authenticate
desc: Analyzes Environmental Markers to resolve a Resolved Identity DNA.

name: SkinAuthorizer
desc: Decides whether principal may apply binding.

name: SkinBinding
desc: AI Agent Guide

name: SkinBinding.command
desc:
A command binding: the user function applies other cells itself
(e.g. a Cell.txApply batch) and returns a JSON-safe result such as
true or a report.

name: SkinBinding.state
desc:
A state binding: the user function returns the next value (or a
Future of it, or a Pulse) and must not call update itself.

name: argumentSchema
desc:
Hand-written JSON Schema hint for MCP tools/list. Wins over
ledger-observed shapes; null falls back to observation then to
the permissive {} schema.

name: cellId
desc: The registered graph name of the target cell.

name: compensation
desc:
Optional compensation closure for ApplyCompensation. The
compensation receives the same wire arguments as the command, so
it knows what to undo.

name: compensationCell
desc: The cell the compensation targets; defaults to target.

name: description
desc:
Human-readable description for MCP tools/list; falls back to the
cell's description.

name: function
desc: The live Dart closure the command runs.

name: functionName
desc: The wire-facing function name.

name: positionalNames
desc:
The schema property name for each positional wire argument, when
the argument schema names properties (target) rather than index
keys ("0").

name: strictCursor
desc:
Honour WireRequest.lastSeenSeq? Opt-in per binding: a cursor
conflict rejects with conflict before the target's apply runs.
A strict binding also rejects a request that omits the cursor
entirely (cursor_required).

name: strictReceiptViolation
desc:
The strict-receipts verdict for a successful apply, or null when
the write shape is the one this binding promises.

name: target
desc: The live target cell, resolved at registration.

name: toApplyCommand
desc: Builds the framework ApplyCommand for a decoded WireRequest.

name: SkinBindingTable
desc: The authoritative registry for every exposed function on the membrane surface.

name: all
desc: A flattened list of every SkinBinding registered in the table.

name: bindingsFor
desc: Returns every SkinBinding associated with a specific cellId.

name: exposedCellIds
desc: The list of all cell IDs currently exposed at the membrane.

name: exposesCell
desc: Whether the cell at cellId has any physical exposure at the membrane.

name: isSealed
desc: Freezes the Somatic Registry.

name: length
desc: The total number of exposed synaptic points (functions) in the registry.

name: lookup
desc: Finds the SkinBinding at the specified somatic coordinates.

name: register
desc: Registers a binding at the Skin Membrane.

name: seal
desc: Freezes the Somatic Registry.

name: SkinCall
desc: The ambient context of one membrane apply.

name: SkinCall.new
desc: Creates an ambient call record.

name: current
desc:
The call currently installed around the apply, or null outside a
membrane apply.

name: deadline
desc: The instant after which a queued request must not start.

name: principal
desc:
The authenticated caller, or null for an in-process request whose
context carried no principal snapshot.

name: pulseContext
desc:
The request's pulse context — the actor the ledger will store when
the binding's pulse is stamped.

name: run
desc: Runs body in a child zone that carries call.

name: SkinCellDescriptor
desc: A description of a single cell's physical surface at the membrane.

name: SkinCellDescriptor.fromJson
desc: Decodes a Skin Form JSON map back into a SkinCellDescriptor.

name: SkinCellDescriptor.new
desc: Creates a new SkinCellDescriptor for a somatic address.

name: cellId
desc: The unique identifier for the cell in the reactive graph.

name: description
desc: A human and AI-readable description of the cell's somatic role.

name: functions
desc: The list of functions physically exposed for this cell.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the descriptor into its Skin Form (JSON) for transport.

name: SkinClient
desc: The authoritative in-process coordinator for stimulating the somatic graph.

name: apply
desc:
Invokes (cellId, function) through the membrane and returns the
target's real ApplyOutcome.

name: events
desc: The full outbound pulse stream (responses, egress, ledger, errors).

name: ledger
desc: Ledger entries after since (inclusive of nothing older).

name: manifest
desc: Fetches the current tool catalogue.

name: observe
desc:
State-change pulses for one cell (skin.egress.<cellId> carrying
WireStateChange).

name: outcomeOf
desc:
The live outcome a WireResponse carries, with honest null and
error handling.

name: verify
desc: Verifies the membrane's ledger (requires a bound ledger).

name: SkinCredentials
desc: The raw data extracted from the transport layer before identity is resolved.

name: SkinCredentials.new
desc: Creates a new SkinCredentials envelope for membrane analysis.

name: metadata
desc: The technical metadata surrounding the signal's arrival.

name: token
desc: The specific authentication marker, such as a Bearer token.

name: SkinError
desc: A failure encountered at the boundary when a nervous signal is rejected.

name: code
desc: The stable somatic failure code.

name: message
desc: A human-readable description of the rejection.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: SkinFunctionDescriptor
desc: A technical description of a single interactable point on the membrane.

name: SkinFunctionDescriptor.fromJson
desc: Decodes a Skin Form JSON map back into a SkinFunctionDescriptor.

name: argumentSchema
desc: The technical blueprint defining the valid arguments for this function.

name: description
desc: A human and AI-readable description of the function's somatic purpose.

name: name
desc: The external Signal Label used to identify this function on the wire.

name: positionalNames
desc:
The schema property name for each positional wire argument (the
binding's validation zipper), when the schema names properties
rather than index keys. Shown to clients so tools/list can teach
them the zipper; old manifests without the field still decode.

name: strictCursor
desc:
Whether callers must provide a lastSeenSeq cursor to ensure
Causal Linkage.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the descriptor into its Skin Form (JSON) for transport.

name: SkinManifest
desc: The system's discovery document, representing the complete external "DNA."

name: SkinManifest.fromJson
desc: Decodes a Skin Form JSON map back into a SkinManifest.

name: SkinManifest.new
desc: Creates a new SkinManifest from a list of cell descriptors.

name: cells
desc: The collection of exposed cells, representing the Somatic Address Records.

name: describe
desc: Assembles the Somatic Index from the current graph and binding state.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the manifest into its Skin Form (JSON) for transport.

name: toolCount
desc: The total number of Synaptic Points (functions) exposed across all cells.

name: SkinMembrane
desc: The master orchestrator of the boundary layer, managing the flow between the somatic graph and the environment.

name: bindings
desc: The authoritative registry of physically exposed pores.

name: close
desc:
Closes the terminal cell, every egress observer, the receipt
join, the ledger-tail subscription and the response stream, and
fails every pending request() with a closed SkinError. The
router is gated first, so a request that was queued but not yet
dispatching is answered closed instead of applying after the
close; an apply already in flight runs to completion (it cannot be
cancelled). The graph and ledger stay open — they belong to the
caller.

name: dispatcher
desc: The dispatch brain behind the router cell.

name: egress
desc: The collection of observation points for exposed cells.

name: graph
desc: The reactive organ representing the entire somatic body.

name: idempotency
desc:
The idempotency store this membrane consults — the memory default,
or the file store the application passed. /ready checks a file
store's directory here.

name: inbound
desc: The entry pore for incoming wire signals.

name: isClosed
desc:
Whether close ran. /ready uses this: a closed membrane is not
ready, no matter how healthy the ledger looks.

name: isExposed
desc:
Whether any function of cellId may cross the skin (binding and
whitelist policy combined).

name: ledger
desc: The system's permanent history, if one is bound.

name: manifest
desc: The current tool catalogue.

name: mayRead
desc:
Whether principal may read cellId through the read routes
(manifest, observe, ledger). A null authorizer reads everything
exposure allows; a non-null one must allow every binding of the
cell. Not cached.

name: mux
desc: The convergence point for all outbound signals.

name: open
desc: Assembles the four cells over graph.

name: outbound
desc: The terminal cell writing to the transport layer.

name: request
desc:
Emits one wire message into the inbound cell and awaits the
correlated response (a WireResponse, WireError or — for
manifest requests — a WireManifestResponse).

name: responses
desc: The unified stream of every signal that survives the egress funnel.

name: router
desc: The cell responsible for dispatching signals to the graph.

name: routerInFlight
desc:
Whether a dispatch is currently inside the router (0 or 1 under
concurrency: 1). For developer panes and tests.

name: routerQueueDepth
desc:
How many requests the router has received but not yet finished
(queued plus the one in flight). For developer panes and tests.

name: whitelist
desc: The optional declarative filter for the membrane.

name: SkinPrincipal
desc: The resolved identity DNA of an external actor at the membrane.

name: SkinPrincipal.anonymous
desc: The unauthenticated identity used when no specific credentials are provided.

name: SkinPrincipal.new
desc: Creates a new SkinPrincipal with an authoritative identity.

name: claims
desc: Additional metadata and claims associated with the identity.

name: id
desc: The stable identifier for the actor.

name: roles
desc: The list of somatic permissions or categories assigned to the actor.

name: SkinPulseTypes
desc: A static taxonomy of names for signals crossing the system membrane.

name: restResponseType
desc: Translates an internal ApplyOutcome into a specific Signal Label for REST responses.

name: resultType
desc: Translates an internal ApplyOutcome into a specific Signal Label for MCP tools.

name: SkinPulses
desc:
Builds a Pulse for a state change, stamped with the current
SkinCall's context when one is active.

name: payload
desc:
Stamps value with the ambient call's context, or returns a bare
pulse when no SkinCall is active.

name: stamp
desc:
Returns pulse unchanged when it already carries an actor, and a
governed copy stamped with the ambient call's context otherwise.

name: SkinRouter
desc: The dispatch brain responsible for governing the journey of signals from the membrane to the somatic graph.

name: authorizer
bindings
desc: The authoritative registry of physically exposed pores.

name: cell
desc: Materialises the router as a framework Cell.asyncMap.

name: clock
desc: The time source for stored idempotency records.

name: closing
desc:
Set by SkinMembrane.close: a request whose dispatch starts after
this is answered closed and never applies. An apply already in
flight is not cancelled — the caller's timeout is its only bound,
and a hung apply keeps holding the serial queue.

name: descriptions
desc: The technical map used to provide human-readable context in the manifest.

name: functionLabelFor
desc:
The binding's wire-facing name for a written row's receipt id, when
this router applied that row. null on a miss (replayed history or
an inner txApply closure) — the stored text is then kept.

name: graph
desc: The reactive organ representing the entire somatic body.

name: idempotency
desc: A cache of recently processed impulses to prevent duplicate transitions.

name: inFlight
desc:
Dispatches currently inside the router (0 or 1 under
concurrency: 1).

name: ledger
desc: The system's permanent history, used for cursor-based integrity checks.

name: mayRead
desc:
Whether principal may read cellId through the read routes
(manifest, observe, ledger). A null authorizer reads everything
exposure allows. A non-null one must allow every binding of
the cell; a throwing hook denies. Not cached: every read decision
consults the hook.

name: onApplied
desc: An optional hook triggered every time a Command Journey completes.

name: onRouted
desc:
Called from route()'s finally, once per dispatch — including a
dispatch whose waiter already gave up. The membrane decrements its
maxQueued slot here.

name: queueDepth
desc:
Requests the router has received but not yet finished (queued plus
the one in flight).

name: route
desc: Processes a single Nervous Signal arriving from the environment.

name: strictReceipts
desc:
Whether a ledgered apply must have written exactly the receipt it
returned (the strict rule for state/raw bindings). Ignored when
no ledger is bound.

name: whitelist
desc: The optional declarative filter for the membrane.

name: SkinUnlisted
desc:
What cellId → {functionName} exposure policy does with a binding
the map does not name.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: SkinWhitelist
desc: cellId → {functionName} exposure policy.

name: SkinWhitelist.new
desc: Creates a whitelist from cellId → functions entries.

name: allows
desc: Whether (cellId, functionName) may cross the skin.

name: cellIds
desc: All whitelisted cell ids.

name: empty
desc: A whitelist that exposes nothing.

name: functionsFor
desc: All whitelisted functions for cellId.

name: mentionsCell
desc: Whether the whitelist mentions cellId at all.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: unlisted
desc:
How bindings the map does not name are treated. SkinUnlisted.hide
keeps the historical rule: only listed functions cross the skin.

name: SystemContextBridge
desc:
A bridge that resolves every incoming signal's base context to
Context.system.

name: SystemContextBridge.new
desc: Creates a new SystemContextBridge to grant a system base context.

name: resolve
desc: Resolves any principal to the authoritative Context.system.

name: WireError
desc: A failure signal indicating that a request was rejected before reaching the core graph.

name: WireError.fromJson
desc: Decodes a raw JSON map into a WireError.

name: WireError.new
desc: Creates a new WireError envelope.

name: clientCorrelationId
desc: The optional ID provided by the caller, echoed verbatim.

name: code
desc: A stable identifier for the type of failure.

name: correlationId
desc: The authoritative identifier for the failed impulse.

name: kind
desc: The stable identifier used to distinguish this message type on the wire.

name: message
desc: A human and AI-readable description of why the signal was rejected.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the error into a JSON-safe map for transport.

name: WireLedgerEntry
desc: A wrapper for an authoritative audit record from the system's permanent history.

name: WireLedgerEntry.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireLedgerEntry encoded by toJson.

name: entry
desc: The technical forensic record containing the audit data.

name: kind
desc: The stable name of the message type used for decoding.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the message into a JSON-safe map.

name: WireManifestRequest
desc: A discovery signal sent to the system to request a list of available tools and cells.

name: WireManifestRequest.fromJson
desc:
Decodes a raw JSON map into a WireManifestRequest. A missing
correlationId decodes as null, like every other optional key.

name: WireManifestRequest.new
desc: Creates a new WireManifestRequest envelope.

name: correlationId
desc: The optional correlation id of this discovery impulse.

name: kind
desc: The stable identifier used to distinguish this message type on the wire.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the request into a JSON-safe map for transport.

name: WireManifestResponse
desc: The envelope carrying the system's somatic catalog back to a discovery client.

name: WireManifestResponse.fromJson
desc: Decodes a raw JSON map into a WireManifestResponse.

name: WireManifestResponse.new
desc: Creates a new WireManifestResponse envelope.

name: correlationId
desc:
The optional correlation id echoed from the requesting impulse.
Omitted on the wire when null.

name: kind
desc: The stable identifier used to distinguish this message type on the wire.

name: manifest
desc: The catalog of exposed tools and cells available for interaction.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the manifest response into a JSON-safe map for transport.

name: WireMessage
desc: The universal envelope for every signal crossing the system's membrane.

name: WireMessage.fromJson
desc: Decodes a raw JSON map into the correct WireMessage type.

name: kind
desc: The stable name of the message type used for decoding.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the message into a JSON-safe map.

name: WireNotification
desc: A fire-and-forget signal used for environmental pings and lightweight updates.

name: WireNotification.fromJson
desc: Decodes a raw JSON map into a WireNotification impulse.

name: WireNotification.new
desc: Creates a new WireNotification envelope.

name: kind
desc: The stable identifier used to distinguish this message type on the wire.

name: method
desc:
The specific name of the notification event or method.///
In the framework's biological metaphor, this identifies the type of
Transient Impulse being sent (e.g., ping). It tells the receiver
how to interpret the temporary signal crossing the Skin Membrane.

name: params
desc: The data payload associated with the notification.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the notification into a JSON-safe map for transport.

name: WireOutcome
desc: The wire-safe JSON read model of a cell's application result.

name: WireOutcome.fromJson
desc: Decodes the Skin Form back into a WireOutcome model.

name: WireOutcome.new
desc: Creates a new WireOutcome envelope.

name: argumentsOmitted
desc: Whether one or more arguments in the receipt were replaced by placeholders.

name: kind
desc: The specific status of the transition.

name: reason
desc: The explanation for why a transition was denied.

name: reasonOmitted
desc: Whether the rejection reason was replaced by a placeholder during encoding.

name: receipt
desc: The technical metadata for the transition.

name: result
desc: The resulting value produced by the cell.

name: resultOmitted
desc: Whether the result was too complex for JSON and was replaced by a placeholder.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the outcome into its Skin Form for transport.

name: WirePulseGate
desc: An integrity gate that ensures only valid wire signals enter the somatic graph.

name: action
desc:
Validates the execution of a functional action and its associated arguments
on the host cell, supporting Hybrid Convergence (Sync/Async).

name: call
desc:
The primary entry point for the Integrity Gate, executing the
validation pipeline for a specific object or state mutation.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: link
desc:
Validates the establishment of a reactive link from a candidate Cell
to the host cell, supporting Hybrid Convergence (Sync/Async).

name: operator +
desc:
Composes this Integrity Gate (TestCell) with another validation rule
using the Compositional Algebra of the framework.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: pulse
desc:
Validates an incoming pulse intended for processing by the host cell,
supporting Hybrid Convergence (Sync/Async).

name: purity
desc:
A rule's purity. Defaults to Purity.pure; rules that perform
external I/O must override — a rule that reads external state (a
clock, an environment variable, a read-only database) to
Purity.readOnlyExternal, a rule that mutates external state (rare;
mostly misuse) to Purity.effectful and be journalled.

name: version
desc:
A rule's version. Defaults to '0.0.0'; subclasses should override
with a stable string. See Receptor.version.

name: WireReceipt
desc:
The read model of a cell's physical state transition, stripped of live
references for transport.

name: WireReceipt.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireReceipt encoded by wireReceiptJson or toJson.

name: WireRequest
desc:
An envelope for an incoming command sent from the outside world into the system.///
In the framework's biological metaphor, WireRequest is a Nervous Signal
that has just touched the Skin Membrane. It carries the instructions
needed to start a Command Journey inside the reactive graph.

name: WireRequest.fromJson
desc: Decodes a raw JSON map into a WireRequest envelope.

name: WireRequest.new
desc: Creates a new WireRequest envelope to carry a signal into the system.

name: cellId
desc: The unique name of the cell that this request is trying to reach.

name: clientCorrelationId
desc: An optional ID provided by the caller to identify the response on their end.

name: correlationId
desc: The unique ID used to track a specific request through the system.

name: deadline
desc:
The instant after which a request that is still queued must not
start.

name: function
desc: The name of the action or update to perform on the target cell.

name: kind
desc: The stable identifier used to distinguish this message type on the wire.

name: lastSeenSeq
desc: The sequence number of the last entry the caller saw in the Forensic Ledger.

name: named
desc: The data passed by name, allowing for tagged arguments.

name: positional
desc: The data passed by position, stored as a string-keyed map for JSON safety.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the message into a JSON-safe map.

name: WireResponse
desc: An envelope for an outbound result: the official response to a request.

name: WireResponse.fromJson
desc: Decodes a raw JSON map into a WireResponse envelope.

name: WireResponse.new
desc: Creates a new WireResponse envelope to carry a result back through the membrane.

name: clientCorrelationId
desc:
An optional ID provided by the caller to help them identify the response
on their end.

name: correlationId
desc: The unique ID that links this response to the request that started it.

name: kind
desc: The stable identifier used to distinguish this message type on the wire.

name: ledgerSeqs
desc:
The sequence numbers of the ledger rows this apply covered, in
ascending order.

name: outcome
desc: The live internal result produced by the target cell.

name: outcomeJson
desc: The wire-safe JSON version of the cell's result.

name: pendingReceipt
desc: Whether the permanent record for this change is still being written to the ledger.

name: receiptJson
desc: A snapshot of the last known state of the ledger receipt for this cell.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the response into a JSON-safe map for transport.

name: WireStateChange
desc: An outbound observation signal indicating that a cell's physical state has changed.

name: WireStateChange.fromJson
desc: Decodes a raw JSON map into a WireStateChange observation.

name: WireStateChange.new
desc: Creates a new WireStateChange observation envelope.

name: cellId
desc: The unique name of the cell that has changed.

name: kind
desc: The stable identifier used to distinguish this message type on the wire.

name: payload
desc:
The new state value of the cell, provided as a JSON-serializable object.  ///
In the framework's biological metaphor, this is the Phenotype. It
represents the observable traits of the cell immediately following a
Somatic State Transition.

name: pendingReceipt
desc: Whether the permanent record for this change is still being written to the ledger.

name: receipt
desc: The forensic evidence for the state change, if available.

name: toJson
desc: Converts the observation into a JSON-safe map for transport.

name: buildEgressCells
desc:
Sets up observers to send signals out of the system for cells that do not
use a forensic ledger.

name: buildInboundCell
desc:
Builds the inbound transport cell from the framework's own
Cell.ingress.

name: buildMuxCell
desc: Builds the somatic convergence point for all outbound wire signals.

name: buildOutboundCell
desc: Builds the terminal egress point of the membrane, connecting the internal graph to the physical transport.

name: idempotencyFingerprint
desc:
The SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact request. Canonical JSON sorts
keys, so argument order does not matter; null and an omitted
argument map hash the same (both become {}), and lastSeenSeq is
part of the object so a missing cursor and an explicit null match
while a different cursor does not.

name: idempotencyStoreKey
desc:
The store key for a caller id: actor-scoped, so alice and bob do
not share keys even when they reuse the same client id.

name: mcpEscapedToolName
desc: The escaped MCP wire name for a binding.

name: mcpResourceSpecs
desc: Translates a SkinManifest into neutral resource specs for AI observation.

name: mcpToolSpecs
desc: Translates a SkinManifest into neutral tool specs for AI discovery.

name: mcpUnknownToolResult
desc: The tool result an SDK adapter returns for an unknown tool call.

name: mergeSchemas
desc: Merges two somatic blueprints into a single, wider DNA structure.

name: nextCorrelationId
desc:
Mints the next correlation id with prefix (skin, rest,
remote). Opaque to everyone except the membrane's waiter matching.

name: principalFrom
desc:
Rebuilds a SkinPrincipal from the snapshot stored in a
PulseContext's others (skin.principal). A missing or malformed
snapshot yields null — it never throws.

name: requireSkinWireVersion
desc: The version gate for a decoded body.

name: resolveMcpToolCall
desc: Resolves an MCP tool name to a binding.

name: schemaForValue
desc:
Derives a best-effort JsonSchema by observing a single somatic value.
/// In the framework's biological metaphor, this is Trait Induction. It
takes a specific Somatic Nutrient (a value) that has successfully
crossed an Integrity Gate and derives the Somatic Blueprint (DNA)
required to represent it.

name: skinErrorStatus
desc:
Code → HTTP status. The contract twin of
test/goldens/wire/errors/: the same codes, the same statuses. A
row in this table means "no receipt exists" — these are pre-apply or
adapter-local codes, never WireResponses.

name: skinPrincipalSnapshot
desc:
The JSON snapshot of a SkinPrincipal for a request context's
others under skin.principal: id, roles, and the claims
jsonEncode accepts. The bearer token is never part of it.

name: skinPulseContext
desc:
The request PulseContext a transport builds for an authenticated
caller.

name: skinWireVersion
desc: The wire version every encoded body carries.

name: validateBindingArguments
desc:
Validates a wire request's arguments against a binding's explicit
SkinBinding.argumentSchema, or returns null when nothing is
enforced.

name: validateJsonSchema
desc: Validates value against an explicit JsonSchema subset.

name: wireLedgerEntryCellId
desc: Extracts the permanent Somatic Address captured within the forensic record.

name: wireLedgerEntryFromJson
desc: Decodes a Skin Form JSON map back into a forensic record.

name: wireLedgerEntryJson
desc: Converts a forensic record into its wire-safe Skin Form.

name: wireOutcomeFromJson
desc: Decodes the wire form into the WireOutcome read model.

name: wireOutcomeJson
desc:
Encodes a live ApplyOutcome to its wire JSON form, sanitising any
value JSON cannot encode (see WireOutcome.resultOmitted).

name: wireOutcomeKind
desc: The kind tag for outcome: accepted, rejected, or staged.

name: wireReceiptJson
desc: Encodes an ApplyReceipt to its wire JSON form.

name: wireStateChangeForEntry
desc: Converts a LedgerEntry into an authoritative WireStateChange signal.

name: withWire
desc:
Stamps fields with wire: "1". Encode-time only: no
WireMessage subclass keeps the field, so no constructor changed.

name: cell_skin_api_chooser
desc: API Chooser — cell_skin

name: cell_skin_io
desc: The dart:io barrel of the skin.

name: FileIdempotencyStore
desc: The durable sibling of MemoryIdempotencyStore.

name: checkReady
desc:
Whether the directory and the lock file still exist. Catches I/O
errors and returns false — it never throws into the HTTP
handler.

name: open
desc: Opens (or creates) the store at directory.

name: cell_skin_rest
desc: The RESTful transport binding for the somatic boundary.

name: RestAdapter
desc: The physical realization of a RESTful and SSE pore at the boundary layer.

name: activeSubscriptions
desc:
The number of live SSE subscriptions (observability for tests and
operations).

name: bind
desc:
Binds the REST adapter to a physical network address and port.///
In the framework's biological metaphor, this method sensitizes the pore.
It opens a specific communication channel at the Skin Membrane, allowing
the system to receive discovery impulses, command signals, and forensic
audit streams via HTTP and SSE.

name: close
desc: Stops the server and all subscriptions.

name: membrane
desc: The reactive organ orchestrating the somatic graph.

name: onRequestLog
desc:
The metrics hook, called once per finished request from a
finally. null means no logging.

name: onServerError
desc:
Receives server-side exceptions (a frame that failed to encode, a
verify that threw). null means the failure is not logged. The
exception never reaches the response body.

name: port
desc: The bound port (after an ephemeral bind, this is the real port).

name: SkinRequestLog
desc: One finished HTTP request: a record for the metrics hook.

name: SkinRequestSample
desc: One finished HTTP request as seen by SkinRequestLog.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: kDefaultMaxBodyBytes
desc: The default somatic saturation limit for an incoming impulse at a membrane pore.
